verdict.rationale: An end-user consent and revocation portal is a fair question for an open-banking data aggregator, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack covers only data products (balances, transactions, account ownership), onboarding, webhooks, testing personas and the MCP toolkit. None of it documents a surface where end users can see or revoke which apps hold access to their bank data.

support.subject: As an ops lead, end users can see and revoke what they've shared — a documented consent surface or portal where a user manages which apps hold access to their bank data
